points.description: Initialisation: arrange the neurons/weights in the required lattice topology and initialise weights randomly so that all are different.
Sample an input vector from the input space and perform similarity matching to find the winning neuron in the lattice.
Update the weights of the winning neuron and its neighbours as determined by the neighbourhood function.
Reduce the neighbourhood size and decay the learning rate; repeat sampling until ordering and convergence are complete, then stop.
points.partial_credit: Half of the marks (0.25) if only the decay/shrinking or only the loop/stopping condition is given.
